title: Extract embeddings engine from mmry into vqtrs
description: Standalone lean embeddings + reranking engine (vqtrs-core) backed by fastembed: ONNX models + Qwen3 candle backend + cross-encoder reranking. Exposes a Rust lib, a CLI (vqtrs), and an OpenAI-compatible HTTP server (vqtrs-api). Replaces mmry's in-process embeddings.

title: vqtrs-core engine: ONNX embedding backend
description: fastembed TextEmbedding over ort. ~30-model catalog (MiniLM/BGE/GTE/E5/Nomic/Snowflake/Jina), name resolution by HF code or variant, dimension probe fallback. &self inference via Mutex (fastembed embed is &mut self).
close_reason: Implemented and verified this session: builds clean under the maximal clippy preset, 7 unit tests + doctest pass, and embeddings + rerank exercised end-to-end via CLI and HTTP.

title: Server config file + token-accurate usage
description: vqtrs-api config is flags/env only and usage.prompt_tokens is a char/4 estimate. Add a config file and real tokenizer-based token counts.

title: Qwen3 candle embedding backend
description: Qwen3TextEmbedding via from_hf (candle, CPU/F32). Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B/4B/8B in catalog. Lock-free &self embed. Boxed enum variants to keep Inner pointer-sized.
close_reason: Implemented and verified this session: builds clean under the maximal clippy preset, 7 unit tests + doctest pass, and embeddings + rerank exercised end-to-end via CLI and HTTP.

title: Cross-encoder reranking
description: TextRerank (BGE base/v2-m3, Jina v1-turbo/v2-base). Mutex-guarded (&mut self), sorted by score desc, optional top_k and return_documents.
close_reason: Implemented and verified this session: builds clean under the maximal clippy preset, 7 unit tests + doctest pass, and embeddings + rerank exercised end-to-end via CLI and HTTP.

title: OpenAI-compatible HTTP server (vqtrs-api)
description: axum server: POST /v1/embeddings (OpenAI shape, string+array input), POST /rerank (Cohere/Jina shape), GET /v1/models, GET /health. spawn_blocking for inference, lazy reranker load, CORS, env/flag config.
close_reason: Implemented and verified this session: builds clean under the maximal clippy preset, 7 unit tests + doctest pass, and embeddings + rerank exercised end-to-end via CLI and HTTP.

title: CLI: embed / rerank / models
description: vqtrs binary. embed/rerank read args or stdin lines; JSON to stdout (--pretty). models lists catalog (table or --json). Fully sync, no tokio.
close_reason: Implemented and verified this session: builds clean under the maximal clippy preset, 7 unit tests + doctest pass, and embeddings + rerank exercised end-to-end via CLI and HTTP.

title: Maximal-lint clean, tests, README
description: Clean under workspace deny-all clippy preset (pedantic/nursery/cargo + unwrap/expect/panic). 7 catalog unit tests + doctest. README. Added allow-{unwrap,expect,panic}-in-tests to clippy.toml. Removed dead template core; engine crate named vqtrs-core; error type VqtrsError.
close_reason: Implemented and verified this session: builds clean under the maximal clippy preset, 7 unit tests + doctest pass, and embeddings + rerank exercised end-to-end via CLI and HTTP.

title: mmry integration: point RemoteBackendConfig at vqtrs-api
description: Drop mmry's embeddings/ + sparse_embeddings/ modules; route embedding through the existing HTTP fallback in wrapper.rs to a running vqtrs-api. Keeps mmry's storage-vs-retrieval split clean.

title: Sparse + BGE-M3 dense/sparse embeddings
description: Expose SparseTextEmbedding and BGE-M3 joint dense/sparse via the engine + API. mmry uses sparse vectors today; needed before mmry can fully cut over.

title: GPU acceleration passthrough for Qwen3 (metal/cuda)
description: Thread fastembed candle accel features (metal/cuda/mkl/accelerate) through vqtrs-core features and pick Device accordingly instead of hardcoded Device::Cpu.
